v.t: Praise be to God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Maker of the angels messengers with wings—double, triple, and quadruple. He adds to creation as He wills. God is Able to do all things
v.l: Al-Hamdu Lillahi Fatiri As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Ja`ili Al-Mala'ikati Rusulaan 'Uli 'Ajnihatin Mathna Wa Thulatha Wa Ruba`a Yazidu Fi Al-Khalqi Ma Yasha'u 'Inna Allaha `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: Whatever mercy God unfolds for the people, none can withhold it. And if He withholds it, none can release it thereafter. He is the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom
v.l: Ma Yaftahi Allahu Lilnnasi Min Rahmatin Fala Mumsika Laha Wa Ma Yumsik Fala Mursila Lahu Min Ba`dihi Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: O people! Remember God’s blessings upon you. Is there a creator other than God who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He. So how are you misled
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu Adhkuru Ni`mata Allahi `Alaykum Hal Min Khaliqin Ghayru Allahi Yarzuqukum Mina As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Fa'anna Tu'ufakuna

v.t: If they reject you, messengers before you were also rejected. To God all matters are returned
v.l: Wa 'In Yukadhibuka Faqad Kudhibat Rusulun Min Qablika Wa 'Ila Allahi Turja`u Al-'Umuru

v.t: O people! The promise of God is true; so let not the lowly life seduce you, and let not the Tempter tempt you away from God
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu 'Inna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Fala Taghurrannakumu Al-Haya Atu Ad-Dunya Wa La Yaghurrannakum Billahi Al-Gharuru

v.t: Satan is an enemy to you, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his gang to be among the inmates of the Inferno
v.l: Inna Ash-Shaytana Lakum `Aduwun Fa Attakhidhuhu `Aduwaan 'Innama Yad`u Hizbahu Liyakunu Min 'Ashabi As-Sa`iri

v.t: Those who disbelieve will suffer a harsh punishment, but those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a great reward
v.l: Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lahum `Adhabun Shadidun Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Lahum Maghfiratun Wa 'Ajrun Kabirun

v.t: What of him whose evil deed was made attractive to him, and so he regards it as good? God leads astray whomever He wills, and He guides whomever He wills. Therefore, do not waste yourself sorrowing over them. God knows exactly what they do
v.l: Afaman Zuyyina Lahu Su'u `Amalihi Fara'ahu Hasanaan Fa'inna Allaha Yuđillu Man Yasha'u Wa Yahdi Man Yasha'u Fala Tadh/hab Nafsuka `Alayhim Hasaratin 'Inna Allaha `Alimun Bima Yasna`una

v.t: God is He who sends the winds, which agitate clouds, which We drive to a dead land, and thereby revive the ground after it had died. Likewise is the Resurrection
v.l: Wa Allahu Al-Ladhi 'Arsala Ar-Riyaha Fatuthiru Sahabaan Fasuqnahu 'Ila Baladin Mayyitin Fa'ahyayna Bihi Al-'Arđa Ba`da Mawtiha Kadhalika An-Nushuru

v.t: Whoever desires honor—all honor belongs to God. To Him ascends speech that is pure, and He elevates righteous conduct. As for those who plot evil, a terrible punishment awaits them, and the planning of these will fail
v.l: Man Kana Yuridu Al-`Izzata Falillahi Al-`Izzatu Jami`aan 'Ilayhi Yas`adu Al-Kalimu At-Tayyibu Wa Al-`Amalu As-Salihu Yarfa`uhu Wa Al-Ladhina Yamkuruna As-Sayyi'ati Lahum `Adhabun Shadidun Wa Makru 'Ula'ika Huwa Yaburu

v.t: God created you from dust, then from a small drop; then He made you pairs. No female conceives, or delivers, except with His knowledge. No living thing advances in years, or its life is shortened, except it be in a Record. That is surely easy for God
v.l: Wa Allahu Khalaqakum Min Turabin Thumma Min Nutfatin Thumma Ja`alakum 'Azwajaan Wa Ma Tahmilu Min 'Untha Wa La Tađa`u 'Illa Bi`ilmihi Wa Ma Yu`ammaru Min Mu`ammarin Wa La Yunqasu Min `Umurihi 'Illa Fi Kitabin 'Inna Dhalika `Ala Allahi Yasirun

v.t: The two seas are not the same. One is fresh, sweet, good to drink, while the other is salty and bitter. Yet from each you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through them, so that you may seek of His bounty, so that you may give thanks
v.l: Wa Ma Yastawi Al-Bahrani Hadha `Adhbun Furatun Sa'ighun Sharabuhu Wa Hadha Milhun 'Ujajun Wa Min Kullin Ta'kuluna Lahmaan Tariyaan Wa Tastakhrijuna Hilyatan Talbasunaha Wa Tara Al-Fulka Fihi Mawakhira Litabtaghu Min Fađlihi Wa La`allakum Tashkuruna

v.t: He merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night; and He regulates the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term. Such is God, your Lord; His is the sovereignty. As for those you call upon besides Him, they do not possess a speck
v.l: Yuliju Al-Layla Fi An-Nahari Wa Yuliju An-Nahara Fi Al-Layli Wa Sakhkhara Ash-Shamsa Wa Al-Qamara Kullun Yajri Li'jalin Musammaan Dhalikumu Allahu Rabbukum Lahu Al-Mulku Wa Al-Ladhina Tad`una Min Dunihi Ma Yamlikuna Min Qitmirin
w: (as much as) the membrane of a date-seed

v.t: If you pray to them, they cannot hear your prayer. And even if they heard, they would not answer you. And on the Day of Resurrection, they will reject your partnership. None informs you like an Expert
v.l: In Tad`uhum La Yasma`u Du`a'akum Wa Law Sami`u Ma Astajabu Lakum Wa Yawma Al-Qiyamati Yakfuruna Bishirkikum Wa La Yunabbi'uka Mithlu Khabirin

v.t: O people! It is you who are the poor, in need of God; while God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu 'Antumu Al-Fuqara'u 'Ila Allahi Wa Allahu Huwa Al-Ghaniyu Al-Hamidu

v.t: If He wills, He can do away with you, and produce a new creation
v.l: In Yasha' Yudh/hibkum Wa Ya'ti Bikhalqin Jadidin

v.t: And that would not be difficult for God
v.l: Wa Ma Dhalika `Ala Allahi Bi`azizin

v.t: No burdened soul can carry the burden of another. Even if one weighted down calls for help with its burden, nothing can be lifted from it, even if they were related. You are to warn those who fear their Lord inwardly, and perform the prayer. He who purifies himself purifies himself for his own good. To God is the ultimate return
v.l: Wa La Taziru Waziratun Wizra 'Ukhra Wa 'In Tad`u Muthqalatun 'Ila Himliha La Yuhmal Minhu Shay'un Wa Law Kana Dha Qurba 'Innama Tundhiru Al-Ladhina Yakhshawna Rabbahum Bil-Ghaybi Wa 'Aqamu As-Salaata Wa Man Tazakka Fa'innama Yatazakka Linafsihi Wa 'Ila Allahi Al-Masiru

v.t: Not equal are the blind and the seeing
v.l: Wa Ma Yastawi Al-'A`ma Wa Al-Basiru

v.t: Nor are the darkness and the light
v.l: Wa La Az-Zulumatu Wa La An-Nur

v.t: Nor are the shade and the torrid heat
v.l: Wa La Az-Zillu Wa La Al-Haruru

v.t: Nor are equal the living and the dead. God causes whomever He wills to hear, but you cannot make those in the graves hear
v.l: Wa Ma Yastawi Al-'Ahya'u Wa La Al-'Amwatu 'Inna Allaha Yusmi`u Man Yasha'u Wa Ma 'Anta Bimusmi`in Man Fi Al-Quburi

v.t: You are only a warner
v.l: In 'Anta 'Illa Nadhirun

v.t: We sent you with the truth; a bearer of good news, and a warner. There is no community but a warner has passed through it
v.l: Inna 'Arsalnaka Bil-Haqqi Bashiraan Wa Nadhiraan Wa 'In Min 'Ummatin 'Illa Khala Fiha Nadhirun

v.t: If they disbelieve you, those before them also disbelieved. Their messengers came to them with the clear proofs, with the Psalms, and with the Enlightening Scripture
v.l: Wa 'In Yukadhibuka Faqad Kadhaba Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Ja'at/hum Rusuluhum Bil-Bayyinati Wa Biz-Zuburi Wa Bil-Kitabi Al-Muniri

v.t: Then I seized those who disbelieved—so how was My rejection
v.l: Thumma 'Akhadhtu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fakayfa Kana Nakiri

v.t: Have you not seen that God sends down water from the sky? With it We produce fruits of various colors. And in the mountains are streaks of white and red—varying in their hue—and pitch-black
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Allaha 'Anzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'akhrajna Bihi Thamaratin Mukhtalifaan 'Alwanuha Wa Mina Al-Jibali Judadun Biđun Wa Humrun Mukhtalifun 'Alwanuha Wa Gharabibu Sudun

v.t: Likewise, human beings, animals, and livestock come in various colors. From among His servants, the learned fear God. God is Almighty, Oft-Forgiving
v.l: Wa Mina An-Nasi Wa Ad-Dawabbi Wa Al-'An`am Mukhtalifun 'Alwanuhu Kadhalika 'Innama Yakhsha Allaha Min `Ibadihi Al-`Ulama'u 'Inna Allaha `Azizun Ghafurun

v.t: Those who recite the Book of God, and perform the prayer, and spend of what We have provided for them, secretly and publicly, expect a trade that will not fail
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Yatluna Kitaba Allahi Wa 'Aqamu As-Salaata Wa 'Anfaqu Mimma Razaqnahum Sirraan Wa `Alaniyatan Yarjuna Tijaratan Lan Tabura

v.t: He will pay them their dues in full, and will increase them from His bounty. He is Forgiving and Appreciative
v.l: Liyuwaffiyahum 'Ujurahum Wa Yazidahum Min Fađlihi 'Innahu Ghafurun Shakurun
w: That He may give them in full

v.t: What We inspired in you, of the Book, is the truth, confirming what preceded it. God is Well-Informed of His servants, All-Seeing
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhi 'Awhayna 'Ilayka Mina Al-Kitabi Huwa Al-Haqqu Musaddiqaan Lima Bayna Yadayhi 'Inna Allaha Bi`ibadihi Lakhabirun Basirun

v.t: Then We passed the Book to those of Our servants whom We chose. Some of them wrong their souls, and some follow a middle course, and some are in the foremost in good deeds by God’s leave; that is the greatest blessing
v.l: Thumma 'Awrathna Al-Kitaba Al-Ladhina Astafayna Min `Ibadina Faminhum Zalimun Linafsihi Wa Minhum Muqtasidun Wa Minhum Sabiqun Bil-Khayrati Bi'idhni Allahi Dhalika Huwa Al-Fađlu Al-Kabiru

v.t: The Gardens of Eden, which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with gold bracelets and pearls, and their garments therein will be of silk
v.l: Jannatu `Adnin Yadkhulunaha Yuhallawna Fiha Min 'Asawira Min Dhahabin Wa Lu'ulu'uaan Wa Libasuhum Fiha Harirun

v.t: And they will say, “Praise God, who has lifted all sorrow from us. Our Lord is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative
v.l: Wa Qalu Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi 'Adh/haba `Anna Al-Hazana 'Inna Rabbana Laghafurun Shakurun

v.t: He Who settled us in the Home of Permanence, by His grace, where boredom will not touch us, and fatigue will not afflict us.”
v.l: Al-Ladhi 'Ahallana Dara Al-Muqamati Min Fađlihi La Yamassuna Fiha Nasabun Wa La Yamassuna Fiha Lughubun

v.t: As for those who disbelieve, for them is the Fire of Hell, wherein they will never be finished off and die, nor will its punishment be lightened for them. Thus We will repay every ingrate
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lahum Naru Jahannama La Yuqđa `Alayhim Fayamutu Wa La Yukhaffafu `Anhum Min `Adhabiha Kadhalika Najzi Kulla Kafurin

v.t: And they will scream therein, “Our Lord, let us out, and we will act righteously, differently from the way we used to act.” Did We not give you a life long enough, in which anyone who wanted to understand would have understood? And the warner did come to you. So taste. The evildoers will have no helper
v.l: Wa Hum Yastarikhuna Fiha Rabbana 'Akhrijna Na`mal Salihaan Ghayra Al-Ladhi Kunna Na`malu 'Awalam Nu`ammirkum Ma Yatadhakkaru Fihi Man Tadhakkara Wa Ja'akumu An-Nadhiru Fadhuqu Fama Lilzzalimina Min Nasir
w: We give you life long enough

v.t: God is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He knows what the hearts contain
v.l: Inna Allaha `Alimu Ghaybi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Innahu `Alimun Bidhati As-Suduri

v.t: It is He who made you successors on earth. Whoever disbelieves, his disbelief will recoil upon him. The disbelief of the disbelievers adds only to their Lord's disfavor of them. The disbelief of the disbelievers adds only to their perdition
v.l: Huwa Al-Ladhi Ja`alakum Khala'ifa Fi Al-'Arđi Faman Kafara Fa`alayhi Kufruhu Wa La Yazidu Al-Kafirina Kufruhum `Inda Rabbihim 'Illa Maqtaan Wa La Yazidu Al-Kafirina Kufruhum 'Illa Khasaraan

v.t: Say, “Have you considered those partners of yours that you worship instead of God? Show me what they have created on earth. Or do they have any share in the heavens?” Or have We given them a book whose clear teachings they follow? In fact, the wrongdoers promise one another nothing but delusions
v.l: Qul 'Ara'aytum Shuraka'akumu Al-Ladhina Tad`una Min Duni Allahi 'Aruni Madha Khalaqu Mina Al-'Arđi 'Am Lahum Shirkun Fi As-Samawati 'Am 'Ataynahum Kitabaan Fahum `Ala Bayyinatin Minhu Bal 'In Ya`idu Az-Zalimuna Ba`đuhum Ba`đaan 'Illa Ghururaan

v.t: God holds the heavens and the earth, lest they fall apart. And were they to fall apart, there is none to hold them together except He. He is Most Clement, Most Forgiving
v.l: Inna Allaha Yumsiku As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa 'An Tazula Wa La'in Zalata 'In 'Amsakahuma Min 'Ahadin Min Ba`dihi 'Innahu Kana Halimaan Ghafuraan

v.t: And they swore by God with their solemn oaths, that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any other people. Yet when a warner came to them, it only increased them in aversion
v.l: Wa 'Aqsamu Billahi Jahda 'Aymanihim La'in Ja'ahum Nadhirun Layakununna 'Ahda Min 'Ihda Al-'Umami Falamma Ja'ahum Nadhirun Ma Zadahum 'Illa Nufuraan

v.t: Priding themselves on earth, and scheming evil. But evil scheming overwhelms none but its authors. Do they expect anything but the precedent of the ancients? You will not find any change in God’s practice, and you will not find any substitute to God’s practice
v.l: Astikbaraan Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Makra As-Sayyi'i Wa La Yahiqu Al-Makru As-Sayyi'u 'Illa Bi'ahlihi Fahal Yanzuruna 'Illa Sunnata Al-'Awwalina Falan Tajida Lisunnati Allahi Tabdilaan Wa Lan Tajida Lisunnati Allahi Tahwilaan

v.t: Have they not journeyed in the land and observed the fate of those who preceded them? They were superior to them in strength. But nothing can defeat God in the heavens or on Earth. He is indeed Omniscient and Omnipotent
v.l: Awalam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fayanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Wa Kanu 'Ashadda Minhum Quwatan Wa Ma Kana Allahu Liyu`jizahu Min Shay'in Fi As-Samawati Wa La Fi Al-'Arđi 'Innahu Kana `Alimaan Qadiraan

v.t: If God were to punish the people for what they have earned, He would not leave a single living creature on its surface. But He defers them until a stated time. Then, when their time has arrived—God is Observant of His creatures
v.l: Wa Law Yu'uakhidhu Allahu An-Nasa Bima Kasabu Ma Taraka `Ala Zahriha Min Dabbatin Wa Lakin Yu'uakhkhiruhum 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Fa'idha Ja'a 'Ajaluhum Fa'inna Allaha Kana Bi`ibadihi Basiraan
